draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.34, the 50th-best grade among 259 2023 draftees and 2nd of 20 at S. He lasted until pick 160, well after his grade rank (50th): he slid relative to the published grade. Published comparison: Kyle Dugger. Testing concerns: 10-yard split (18th percentile), vertical jump (4th percentile). College production: 71 tackles in 2022, 9th of 20 Ss in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 4 pro, currently with the Jacksonville Jaguars. 47 career games and 20 starts over 3 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. His 2025 season (5 AV) was his best yet. Strengths in 2025: passer rating allowed 49.9 (98th percentile), interceptions 5 (98th percentile), passes defended 9 (89th percentile). Versus the typical Year-3 safety who played: 60.1% season snap share against a median of 51.8%, above the norm.
